theme: Light theme (white & beige dominant) to evoke calmness, clarity, and an editorial 'Awwwards' feel. Darker mid-light navy accents are used for trust, structure, and high contrast typography.

headings.description: Editorial, elegant, premium, perfectly suited for the 'apaisé' (soothed) aesthetic.

body.description: Clean, highly readable, geometric yet warm modern sans-serif.

visual_enhancers: Subtle grain/noise overlay (mix-blend-multiply opacity-20) over beige backgrounds to give a print/editorial feel.
Lenis smooth scrolling (MANDATORY) to give physical weight to the site flow.
Framer Motion for kinetic typography (masked line-by-line reveal on load).
Slow-moving editorial marquee for key brand pillars.

components.name: Navigation & Favicon
components.description: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-white/20). Contains a custom SVG logo (a minimalist 'Y' with a subtle arch or leaf integrated, acting as both main logo and favicon). Must include 3-4 nav links and a primary 'Prendre rendez-vous' CTA.

components.name: Kinetic Hero Section
components.description: Awwwards-style hero. Very large serif typography in French. Must feature a masked line-by-line text reveal on load using Framer Motion. Subtle parallax effect on a highly clipped, editorial background image.

components.name: Editorial Marquee
components.description: Use react-fast-marquee. Text: 'Bien-être de l'entrepreneur • Santé de l'entreprise • Équilibre • Performance •'. Very pale beige background, navy serif text, extremely slow smooth drift.

components.name: Bento Grid (Piliers d'accompagnement)
components.description: Asymmetrical Mode-A 'Tetris' grid layout detailing 'Prendre soin du dirigeant' (mindset, coaching, therapy) and 'Prendre soin de l'entreprise' (legal, accounting, admin). Generous padding (p-8 to p-12), solid flat surfaces with a 1px delicate border, avoiding generic shadows.

components.name: Marketplace Catalogue (Offres)
components.description: Category filters (Juridique, Comptabilité, Bien-être, Croissance). The offer cards should feature abstract soft shapes or treated photography. Hover effects must be premium: subtle image scale, -translate-y-1, and text color shift.

components.name: Competitor Comparison
components.description: A refined Swiss-grid comparison section. Compare Yori vs real French competitors: 1. Shine/Qonto (focuses only on business, ignores mental health). 2. Alan/Moka.care (focuses only on health, ignores business admin). 3. LegalPlace (purely admin/legal, very rigid). Highlight how Yori uniquely combines both the human and the business.

components.name: Offer Detail & Booking Form
components.description: A multi-view/modal or distinct section for 'Prendre rendez-vous'. Use Shadcn components (Form, Input, Textarea, Select, Calendar). Style inputs minimally (e.g., bottom borders only, no bulky boxes) for a premium tactile feel. Must trigger a Sonner success toast upon submission.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Massive typography for the final CTA, minimalist links layout, very dark navy background with off-white text for deep contrast at the bottom of the page.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12, py-24, gap-12 or gap-16 to let elements breathe. Never cramp content.
layouts.grids: Use the Tetris Grid (Mode A) for the bento pillars. Subgrid where necessary to align inner content.

motion.page_load: Staggered fade-up for children, strict masked line-by-line reveal for hero H1.
motion.scroll: Parallax on images, subtle scale-down/fade-in on bento cards as they enter the viewport via Framer Motion useInView.
motion.hover: Button hover: bg turns to navy_light, text remains white. Cards: subtle shadow and image scale.

hero_architecture.description: Minimalist architecture in beige tones. Use in the hero section or background elements.

entrepreneur_calm.description: Calm portrait of an entrepreneur. Use in 'Bien-être', founder, or coaching section.

business_desk.description: Clean minimal desk. Use in 'Juridique / Comptabilité' business services section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Do not rely heavily on generic Shadcn Card wrappers if they restrict asymmetry.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for complex interactives (Select, Input, Calendar, Button) in the booking form.
Implement Framer Motion (`framer-motion`) for the hero text reveal and scroll animations.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='booking-submit-button', data-testid='offer-card').
Use `sonner` for the appointment booking success notification.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main App wrapper.
Create a clean, scalable inline SVG logo for 'Yori' that can also be used as the favicon.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure navy text on beige background passes APCA.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the kinetic hero.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add specific transitions (e.g., `transition: transform 0.3s ease`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Text flow should be natural (mostly left-aligned for editorial).
Always use modern button styles (e.g. pill-shaped or perfectly sharp corners depending on theme) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
